products.variantName: Pot Grown Nordman Fir Real Christmas Tree 100-125cm
products.sourceDescription:
Pot Grown Nordman Fir Real Christmas Tree.

Create an authentic woodland look in your home with this Nordman Fir real Christmas tree.

A festive essential, our real Christmas trees are the traditional choice for a yuletide season to remember.

From the mountains of western Asia comes the very popular Nordman Fir. This Christmas tree boasts soft foliage of dark green and flattened needles.

Gives off an attractive citrus scent when crushed while its reputation for retaining needles means your Nordman Fir will keep its shape over the Christmas period.

Better yet, this Christmas tree comes with its own pot so it's ready to stand in your hallway or living room.

Height:  100-125cm / 3-4ft (Approx.)

Browse even more Real Christmas Trees  online and find the perfect type for your home, from Nordman Fir to Blue Spruce. Buy at B&M Garden Centre stores only.

products.sourceDescription:
Pre Lit Green Christmas Tree With Berries 2ft.

Add a touch of festive charm to your home with this delightful 2ft pre-lit Christmas tree. Decorated with red berries and featuring 20 warm white LED lights, it creates a cosy glow that's perfect for smaller spaces, tabletops or hallways.

The mixed needle design combines hardneedle and PVC foliage for a full, natural look. Wrapped in a rustic hessian-style base, this little tree is ready to display straight out of the box.

Features:


20 warm white LED lights

Decorated with red berries

Mixed hardneedle and PVC foliage

Battery operated – 3 x AA batteries required (not included)

Indoor use only


Colour: Green

Size: 2ft (Approx.)

Weight: 900g (Approx.)

Browse more Artificial Christmas Trees and buy in-store at B&M.

Light Up Stacked Gift Boxes Decoration.

These light-up stacked gift boxes are a brilliant way to add a festive glow to your home this Christmas. Designed to look like a pile of wrapped presents, they bring instant seasonal charm to your garden or outdoor space.

Lit with warm white LEDs, they give off a soft, cosy glow that's perfect for the darker evenings of the festive season. A great find for anyone who loves to go all-out with their Christmas decorating.

Features:


70 warm white LEDs

Stacked gift box design

Warm white glow for a cosy festive feel
